messages.subject: small poll
parts:
Hello distance samplers

Just a short question for those who run aerial DS over hard ground - not sea. How much time (in years or tens of years ?) do you think we need to wait before any terrestrial wildlife (elephants? elk? ducks? Many species at once?) can be surveyed by drone/camera alone at reasonable cost (including recording desk staff cost)?
I know this has been done for long out at sea and I am sure this is already done and published somewhere for big terrestrial animals but I wonder for smaller wildlife...and most importantly, I wonder when do you foresee that total costs will become comparable between the traditional current technic with human and the automatized imagery/video stuff...
Very sorry if this thread already exists....
Thanks for any reply!
Best regards
Pierre
